name: space-game
postStartCommand: if [ -n "$GIT_USER_EMAIL" ] || [ -n "$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL" ]; then git config --global user.email "${GIT_USER_EMAIL:-$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL}"; fi && if [ -n "$GIT_USER_NAME" ] || [ -n "$GIT_AUTHOR_NAME" ]; then git config --global user.name "${GIT_USER_NAME:-$GIT_AUTHOR_NAME}"; fi
